decisions.title: Use Dafny for all business logic
decisions.context: Need high confidence in correctness of financial and inventory operations.
decisions.decision: All business logic modules are written in Dafny and verified with Z3.
decisions.consequences: Higher upfront cost but fewer runtime bugs.

decisions.title: Monolithic deployment
decisions.decision: Deploy as a single ASP.NET Core application.

decisions.title: Use relational databases for transactional data
decisions.context: Orders, payments, inventory need ACID transactions.
decisions.decision: Use relational databases for transactional data.
decisions.consequences: Strong consistency but more schema management.

openRisks.description: External payment gateway may be unavailable.

openRisks.mitigation: Keep modules small and use proven patterns.
openRisks.description: Dafny verification may be complex for large modules.
Search performance may degrade with large catalog.

components.name: Catalog
components.internals: Uses pipeline pattern for search/filter/recommendation processing. Product and category data are stored via repository pattern.

testCases.name: SearchProductsReturnsMatchingProducts
testCases.description: Given a search query, the service returns products whose name or description contains the query.
testCases.expectedBehavior: SearchService.Search(query) returns a sequence of Product with matching name or description.

testCases.name: FilterByCategoryReturnsOnlyCategoryProducts
testCases.description: Filtering by a category returns only products in that category.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Filter(category) returns only products with that category.

testCases.name: RecommendationsBasedOnPurchaseHistory
testCases.description: Given a customer's purchase history, recommendations are generated from related products.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Recommend(customerId) returns a sequence of Product that are not already purchased and are related.

components.responsibility: Manage product catalog: product definitions, categories, search, filtering, recommendations.

components.name: Cart
components.internals: Uses state-machine pattern for cart lifecycle (active, checked-out). Cart items stored in memory via repository pattern.

testCases.name: AddItemIncreasesCartSize
testCases.description: Adding an item to a cart increases the number of items.
testCases.expectedBehavior: AddItem(cart, product, qty) results in cart containing the product with the given quantity.

testCases.name: RemoveItemDecreasesCartSize
testCases.description: Removing an item from a cart decreases the number of items.
testCases.expectedBehavior: RemoveItem(cart, product) results in cart not containing the product.

testCases.name: CheckoutTransitionsToCheckedOut
testCases.description: Checking out a cart transitions it from active to checkedOut.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Checkout(cart) results in cart state being checkedOut.

components.responsibility: Manage shopping cart: add/remove items, update quantities, calculate subtotal.

components.name: Orders
components.internals: Uses state-machine pattern for order lifecycle (pending, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled). Orchestrates payment, inventory, shipping, tax.

testCases.name: CreateOrderFromCart
testCases.description: Creating an order from a cart copies items and calculates totals.
testCases.expectedBehavior: CreateOrder(cart) returns an Order with items matching cart and status pending.

testCases.name: OrderTransitionsToPaidAfterPayment
testCases.description: After successful payment, order status becomes paid.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ProcessPayment(order) results in order status paid.

testCases.name: OrderTransitionsToShippedAfterShipping
testCases.description: After shipping, order status becomes shipped.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ShipOrder(order) results in order status shipped.

components.responsibility: Process orders: create order from cart, manage order lifecycle, apply shipping and tax, integrate with payment and inventory.

components.name: Payment
components.internals: Uses adapter pattern to wrap external payment gateway. Payment state machine (authorized, captured, refunded).

testCases.name: AuthorizePaymentReturnsSuccess
testCases.description: Authorizing a valid payment returns success.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Authorize(amount, token) returns PaymentResult with status authorized.

testCases.name: CapturePaymentReturnsSuccess
testCases.description: Capturing an authorized payment returns success.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Capture(paymentId) returns PaymentResult with status captured.

testCases.name: RefundPaymentReturnsSuccess
testCases.description: Refunding a captured payment returns success.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Refund(paymentId) returns PaymentResult with status refunded.

components.responsibility: Handle payment processing: authorize, capture, refund. Integrate with external payment gateway.

components.name: Inventory
components.internals: Uses repository pattern for stock items. State machine for reservation (available, reserved, outOfStock).

testCases.name: ReserveItemDecrementsStock
testCases.description: Reserving an item reduces available stock.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Reserve(productId, qty) results in stock reduced by qty.

testCases.name: RestockIncrementsStock
testCases.description: Restocking an item increases available stock.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Restock(productId, qty) results in stock increased by qty.

testCases.name: ReserveFailsWhenInsufficientStock
testCases.description: Reserving more than available stock fails.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Reserve(productId, qty) returns failure when qty > stock.

components.responsibility: Manage inventory levels: track stock, reserve items, decrement on order, restock.

components.name: Shipping
components.internals: Uses strategy pattern for different shipping methods (standard, express, overnight).

testCases.name: StandardShippingCostIsPositive
testCases.description: Standard shipping cost is positive for valid weight and destination.
testCases.expectedBehavior: CalculateQuote(weight, destination, standard) returns quote with cost > 0.

testCases.name: ExpressShippingCostGreaterThanStandard
testCases.description: Express shipping cost is greater than standard for same weight and destination.
testCases.expectedBehavior: CalculateQuote(weight, destination, express) > CalculateQuote(weight, destination, standard).

testCases.name: OvernightShippingCostGreaterThanExpress
testCases.description: Overnight shipping cost is greater than express for same weight and destination.
testCases.expectedBehavior: CalculateQuote(weight, destination, overnight) > CalculateQuote(weight, destination, express).

components.responsibility: Calculate shipping costs based on weight, destination, and method.

components.name: Tax
components.internals: Uses strategy pattern for different tax jurisdictions (US, EU, other).

testCases.name: TaxCalculationIsNonNegative
testCases.description: Tax calculation returns non-negative amount for valid inputs.
testCases.expectedBehavior: CalculateTax(amount, jurisdiction) returns tax >= 0.

testCases.name: TaxRateForUSIsPositive
testCases.description: US tax rate is positive for taxable products.
testCases.expectedBehavior: GetTaxRate(jurisdiction, category) returns rate > 0 for US.

testCases.name: TaxForZeroAmountIsZero
testCases.description: Tax on zero amount is zero.
testCases.expectedBehavior: CalculateTax(0, jurisdiction) returns 0.

components.responsibility: Calculate tax based on jurisdiction, product category, and order amount.

components.name: Notifications
components.internals: Uses observer pattern to publish events (order placed, shipped, delivered). Adapter pattern for external email/SMS providers.

testCases.name: SendEmailNotification
testCases.description: Sending an email notification returns success.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Send(channel=email, recipient, template) returns success.

testCases.name: SendSmsNotification
testCases.description: Sending an SMS notification returns success.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Send(channel=sms, recipient, template) returns success.

testCases.name: NotifyOnOrderPlaced
testCases.description: When an order is placed, a notification is sent to the customer.
testCases.expectedBehavior: OnOrderPlaced(order) triggers a notification to the customer's preferred channel.

components.responsibility: Send customer notifications via email, SMS, or push. Manage notification templates and preferences.

components.name: AdminDashboard
components.internals: Uses aggregator pattern to compute dashboard statistics (total sales, order count, low stock).

testCases.name: DashboardShowsTotalSales
testCases.description: Dashboard data includes total sales amount.
testCases.expectedBehavior: GetDashboardData() returns DashboardData with totalSales >= 0.

testCases.name: DashboardShowsOrderCount
testCases.description: Dashboard data includes number of orders.
testCases.expectedBehavior: GetDashboardData() returns DashboardData with orderCount >= 0.

testCases.name: DashboardShowsLowStockItems
testCases.description: Dashboard data includes list of low stock items.
testCases.expectedBehavior: GetDashboardData() returns DashboardData with lowStockItems containing items with stock below threshold.

components.responsibility: Provide admin dashboard: view sales, orders, inventory, and manage products.

components.name: AuditLog
components.internals: Uses repository pattern to store audit events. Events are immutable.

testCases.name: LogEventStoresEvent
testCases.description: Logging an event stores it in the audit log.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Log(event) results in the event being retrievable.

testCases.name: GetEventsReturnsLoggedEvents
testCases.description: Retrieving events returns all logged events.
testCases.expectedBehavior: GetEvents() returns a sequence containing all logged events.

testCases.name: AuditEventHasTimestamp
testCases.description: Every audit event has a timestamp.
testCases.expectedBehavior: AuditEvent.timestamp is non-empty.

components.responsibility: Record audit events for security and compliance: who did what, when.

components.name: RBAC
components.internals: Uses repository pattern for users and roles. State machine for session (active, expired).

testCases.name: AdminHasAllPermissions
testCases.description: Admin role has all permissions.
testCases.expectedBehavior: HasPermission(admin, anyPermission) returns true.

testCases.name: CustomerHasLimitedPermissions
testCases.description: Customer role has only customer permissions.
testCases.expectedBehavior: HasPermission(customer, adminPermission) returns false.

testCases.name: UserWithoutRoleHasNoPermissions
testCases.description: User with no role has no permissions.
testCases.expectedBehavior: HasPermission(userWithNoRole, anyPermission) returns false.

components.responsibility: Role-based access control: manage users, roles, permissions, and enforce authorization.

components.name: Contracts
components.internals: Defines datatypes and interfaces only. No logic.

testCases.name: ProductHasRequiredFields
testCases.description: Product datatype has id, name, price, category.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Product has fields id, name, price, category.

testCases.name: OrderHasStatus
testCases.description: Order datatype has status field.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Order has field status of type OrderStatus.

testCases.name: UserHasRole
testCases.description: User datatype has role field.
testCases.expectedBehavior: User has field role of type Role.

components.responsibility: Shared data types and contracts used across all modules.

components.name: WebApi
components.internals: ASP.NET Core Web API. Controllers call into Dafny modules.

testCases.name: GetProductsEndpointReturnsProducts
testCases.description: GET /api/products returns a list of products.
testCases.expectedBehavior: HTTP 200 with JSON array of products.

testCases.name: CreateOrderEndpointReturnsOrder
testCases.description: POST /api/orders creates an order and returns it.
testCases.expectedBehavior: HTTP 201 with order JSON.

testCases.name: AdminDashboardEndpointRequiresAdmin
testCases.description: GET /api/admin/dashboard requires admin role.
testCases.expectedBehavior: HTTP 403 for non-admin users.

components.responsibility: Expose REST API endpoints for all e-commerce operations.

auth.details: JWT tokens issued by RBAC module

systemContext: A multi-project e-commerce platform providing product catalog management, shopping cart, order processing, payment integration, inventory management, shipping calculation, tax calculation, customer notifications, admin dashboard, product search/filtering/recommendations, audit logging, and role-based access control.

qualityAttributes.target: All business logic verified by Dafny
qualityAttributes.rationale: E-commerce transactions must be correct to avoid financial loss.

qualityAttributes.target: Role-based access control enforced on all admin endpoints

qualityAttributes.rationale: E-commerce must be available for revenue.

deploymentTopology: Monolithic ASP.NET Core application deployed to a cloud VM or container. All modules run in-process. Databases are separate managed services.
